versions.notes: USB networking (gate reachable at 192.168.7.1 over USB-C), over-the-air updates from the device UI, gzipped web assets (about 4x faster page loads), visual marshal and the merged race editor. Upgrading from 1.7.x needs a full wired flash - the partition table changed. Windows and Linux only for USB networking; macOS does not support RNDIS.
